description: This source file defines Express.js routes for managing tags in a notes application, including CRUD operations and listing notes by tag. It includes route definitions with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET /tags to list all tags.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET /tags/:id to retrieve a specific tag by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST /tags to create a new tag.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE /tags/:id to delete a tag.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Handles GET /tags/:id/notes to list notes associated with a tag.
